Primary factory metric = unique Git commits/hour, deduplicated by repository+SHA. Merge commits and Project-memory/control commits count in total throughput and may additionally be classified by type.

Intentional commits SHOULD carry `Schedule-Run: <run_id>` and `Schedule-Cell: <cell>` trailers when repository policy permits; otherwise bind exact SHA in the Project run ledger. PRE: repository universe, exact heads, pre_total_commits_1h, pre_total_commits_24h, previous_hour_total_commits, previous_same_cell_commits. # OCEL v2 RevOps hyperdimensional control graph

Project #2 is the canonical object-centric economic/process memory for the five-cell manufacturing system. This record is intentionally dense: events are never reduced to one case id when they relate to multiple economic, software, human, repository, capability, and revenue objects. Case-centric/XES/CSV views are projections only.

## OCEL v2 truth surface

Represent object types, event types, event-object relations, object-object relations, qualifiers, dynamic attributes, timelines, provenance, standing, authority, receipts, and value attribution. Every material observation/manufacture/qualification/value event SHOULD connect every known relevant object rather than copying the event into multiple siloed cards.

### Core object types (26)

Repository; Commit; PullRequest; Capability; Primitive; Consumer; Human; Organization; Product; Offer; Opportunity; RevenueStream; Contract; Invoice; Payment; ValueOutcome; CustomerRevenueOutcome; DistributionSurface; UI; AshResource; AshAction; Process; Evidence; Memory; ScheduleRun; Falsifier.

### Core event types (39)

repository.observed; capability.discovered; capability.composed; capability.selected; capability.manufactured; capability.qualified; capability.replicated; commit.created; pr.created; pr.qualified; pr.merged; primitive.created; primitive.reused; consumer.discovered; consumer.qualified; distribution.created; ui.exposed; human.interacted; value.hypothesized; value.proved; opportunity.discovered; offer.composed; revenue.capacity_created; revenue.attributed; revenue.realized; customer_revenue.capacity_created; customer_revenue.attributed; customer_revenue.realized; invoice.created; payment.received; retention.signal_observed; expansion.opportunity_discovered; renewal.opportunity_discovered; schedule.started; schedule.completed; memory.read; memory.updated; falsifier.triggered; authority.refused.

### Relation qualifiers

manufactured_by; source_of; generated_from; qualifies; consumes; unlocks; composes_with; depends_on; supersedes; observed_in; evidenced_by; offered_to; paid_by; benefits; generates_revenue_for; generates_revenue_from; attributed_to; distributed_through; interacted_through; implemented_by; exposed_by; authorized_by; falsified_by; remembered_by; caused; enabled; retained_by; expanded_by.

### Dynamic attributes

standing; head_sha; semantic_commit_count; commits_per_hour; consumer_count; qualified_consumer_count; E; E2; Y; R; Q; C; M; V; expected_value; realized_revenue; customer_generated_revenue; pipeline_value; conversion_evidence; distribution_readiness; qualification_strength; evidence_strength; authority_state; currentness; supersession; replay_receipt.

## Dual RevOps objective

1. Revenue FROM users/customers: capability -> product/offer -> organization/human -> contract/invoice/payment -> realized revenue -> reinvestment.
2. Revenue FOR users/customers: capability -> human/Ash UI interaction -> customer process -> value outcome -> customer revenue capacity -> customer realized revenue/retention/expansion -> proof -> stronger offer/adoption.

Never collapse payer, beneficiary, revenue producer, causal capability, evidence, amount/currency when observed, time window, and attribution confidence into one field.

## Ash/Elixir human interaction projection

Manufacture an Elixir/Ash application surface over this graph so humans interact with the same canonical objects instead of a separate CRM truth. Ash Resources project OCEL objects and relations; Ash Actions express bounded transitions; Reactor orchestrates multi-hop revenue/value workflows; Phoenix/LiveView/Ash-oriented UI surfaces expose role-appropriate views.

Required human lenses: Make us revenue; Help them make revenue; Manufacturing telemetry; Object-centric process intelligence.

## Hyperdimensional information-density law

Maximize useful relations and dimensions per canonical memory object rather than card count. One event retains all valid object relations, qualifiers, temporal changes, evidence roots, standing, authority, economic attribution, manufacturing lineage, and process context. Measure density as a vector: object types/event; qualified relations/event; independent evidence roots/event; temporal attributes/object; cross-repo edges; consumer edges; economic/value edges; causal edges; replayable receipts; actionable adjacencies created per memory read.

## Five-cell use

MEASURE emits observations/value signals as OCEL events. EXPLORE emits candidate/composition/value-hypothesis events. SELECT/DEVELOP emits capital-allocation and productization events. IMPLEMENT/QUALIFY emits manufacture/replication/qualification/value-proof events. PORTFOLIO emits merge, attribution, revenue-capacity, reinvestment, supersession, and next-frontier events. All five cells read and update this same object-centric graph through the bounded project-memory-bus.

Preserve UNKNOWN | PARTIAL_ALIVE | ALIVE | BUILD_BROKEN | UNSUPPORTED | typed REFUSED; distinguish observed revenue, qualified revenue capacity, bounded-inferred revenue opportunity, customer-generated revenue evidence, and unsupported claims; zero unreceipted consequential actuation.
